title: The Smart Way to Start Small and Still Win Big
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Check out my free newsletter at https://TKOPOD.com and join my new community at https://TKOwners.com

I sat down with Daniel Cronauer again and we talked all things service & local business. We got into how he’s opening his third gym right next to competitors and stealing their customers with simple tactics that actually work. We also talked about finding marketing shortcuts that cost almost nothing but drive real leads, how to use Facebook groups the smart way, and why most home service businesses never scale past two trucks. We even got into personal stuff like gratitude, childhood money trauma, and how those shape your mindset as a business owner.
